Name: Tobiah, of Tel-Melah
Summary: Named among those who returned from Tel-Melah but could not prove their genealogy (Ezra 2:60; Nehemiah 7:62). Not Tobiah the Ammonite, Nehemiah's opponent.
LifeLesson: Honest records distinguish namesakes; a shared name is not a shared story.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
